## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m compileall -q src dashboard tests`
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Documentation and command examples were updated when needed.
- [ ] No raw, processed, cached, or human-review data is included.
- [ ] Any behavior, schema, or compatibility impact is explicitly described.

## Review notes

Call out known limitations, follow-up work, or decisions that require maintainer review.
